verify.note: verify.py on this request, 180 ± 20 s, 20,000 iterations, seed 1 (2026-11-04)

summary: Keeps 5 Sunder Armor stacks on the boss for a raid with no warrior tank. The raid's Sunder Armor is off.
rotation: Start with 0 Rage. Before the pull, Battle Stance, Charge (15 Rage) and back to Berserker Stance. Battle Shout comes from the raid

Sunder Armor on duty for the raid: 5 stacks from the pull (7.5s of GCDs), before anything but the opening cooldowns, then refreshed in its last 3s, unless it lasts the fight. The raid's Sunder Armor is off
Death Wish in the last 36s, Recklessness in the last 30s

Blood Fury and Berserking in the last 30s. Elune's Light on cooldown, but never during Recklessness or the 15s before it. Mighty Rage Potion in the last 20s, and at the pull too when a second one fits
Bloodrage under 20 Rage. Berserker Rage under 10 (Improved Berserker Rage)
Reckless Swings on cooldown. It is off the GCD, and the next 4 swings give 5 more Rage each
Bloodthirst, then Slam at 60+ Rage right after a main-hand swing, then Whirlwind at 25+ Rage
During execute, Execute comes after Bloodthirst and Whirlwind. Putting it first loses 4.7 DPS on Fury and 22.7 on two-hand Fury
Heroic Strike at 90+ Rage, outside execute
caveats: The duty costs 35.4 DPS at 180s against the same build without it (1009.0 against 1044.4, 20,000 iterations, seed 1). Part of it is the ramp: the warrior's own hits meet fewer stacks for the first 7.5s, where the raid's Sunder was full at once.
The trinket's last use is saved for the last 34s.
Assumed: white hits give Rage by weapon speed, at the level 30 rate even at level 60.
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks, so Heroic Strike stops at rank VIII, and the raid's Battle Shout at VI, Strength of Earth at IV and Grace of Air at II.
Assumed: the crit Rage bonus is for white hits only. Heroic Strike can trigger Unbridled Wrath.
Only one +2% crit elixir. A second (Grizzly) would add 12.0 DPS.
Battlegear of Glory 4-piece isn't counted. It would add 8.8 DPS vs Humanoids.
Saving Death Wish for the last 36s adds 17.4 DPS at 180s and 28.4 at 120s.
Rage from taking raid damage (2 hits a minute, about 9 Rage each) is an estimate.
notes: Request from mksettings with the same arguments as warrior__fury_2h except -apl level60_fury_2h_sunder, then the raid's sunderArmor removed (the duty warrior's Sunder is the only one, as for a raid with no warrior tank). Made as a hand edit of the base request, which is the same. A raid sim variant (docs/raid_sim.md, M1b), in the DPS report since 2026-10-30.
